page.overview:
Who is Killcannon?

Killcannon is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is a supervillain with a durable battlesuit and a laser cannon arm. He was the first villain to be defeated by Invincible and Atom Eve.

He appears to be a large, fair-skinned, muscular man. His left arm is robotic, as he wields a built in laser cannon in place of it.

His right arm lacks armor aside from a silver plate around his wrist which connects to his glove as well as as a shoulder pad. The rest of his body seems to be covered in a black suit with red markings that go under his armor. His torso is covered in a dark gray piece of armor, connecting to his robotic arm and the armor on his right shoulder. His legs, from his feet to his knees, are also covered in armor, except it is light gray.
